messages:
alex: Quick follow-up thread for last night's routing+DNS TTL flap. Short list of owners, please confirm.
mina: Root cause: route selector intermittently routed to wrong region when cert checks timed out. That plus edge TTL drift caused retries to hit other regions.
jorge: I'll own the routing service fix to prefer local endpoints and add a health favoring check. ETA 2026-04-08.
ashley: I'll take DNS side: registrar ticket + edge cache invalidation across regions. ETA 2026-03-29.
ops-bot: Alert snapshot: dns_ttl_variance detected edge=ap-south observed_TTL=5s expected=300s zone=api.redwood.ai
mina: Monitoring + runbook needed: add tls_handshake.timeout_rate metric and a small runbook for on-call with steps to rollback routing change. Owner: alex, ETA 2026-03-31.
alex: I'll draft the runbook and wire the metric to pager when >0.5% for 10m.
jorge: Also adding unit + e2e tests to prevent selector regressions. PR will reference this thread.
ashley: Filed registrar ticket INC-9012 and started cache flush. Linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9012
alex: Summarize actions:
- jorge: routing fix + tests (2026-04-08)
- ashley: registrar + cache flush (2026-03-29)
- alex: monitoring + runbook + pager wiring (2026-03-31)
Please react :thumbsup: if assigned correctly or reply to take ownership.
mina: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created task N-501 in tracker.
